component.name: ZettelApp
component.summary: A Zettelkasten that helps you connect ideas

description.p: ZettelApp is a Zettelkasten note-taking app: atomic notes in Markdown, typed and optionally directed links, mind maps, flashcards and quizzes, and a 2D/3D knowledge graph.

ul.li: Typo-tolerant and optional semantic search, a tag ontology, and link suggestions that learn from what you accept;
Flashcards from your text with SM-2 spaced repetition, and Anki sync;
"Ask your notes" with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI or Z.ai using your own API key;
an MCP server that lets Claude Desktop and other clients search your vault while the app is open;
export to Markdown, a static website, Anki decks, GraphML, Graphviz and more, and imports for Markdown folders, Obsidian vaults and Evernote.

description.p: Everything stays on your computer. Notes can't run scripts, imports are sandboxed, and API keys are kept in the system keyring.

screenshot.caption: The Notes page: the note list, a note with Markdown text and preview, and suggested links
The 3D knowledge graph, coloured by topic cluster

description.p: Diffusion in the graph, network measures in Insights, arrow tips at both ends of a link, Preview and Reading view options, a review of the notes Ask sends, and fixes from the Windows, GNOME, KDE and Xfce passes.

ZettelApp on Linux (.deb, portable archive, Snap and Flatpak) and in the Microsoft Store. A Reading view, folding side panels, a Black (OLED) theme and your own colours, find and replace, several carets, a note list ordered by closeness, graph filters, alarms you can click through to the note, and many fixes.
Word-processor style bold and italic, smarter [[ autocomplete, and a tidier note list menu.
Evernote import, Markdown import improvements for Notion and Obsidian vaults, and a graph tab for the tag ontology.
Fixed a crash when opening a note whose stored time has no time zone.
Tag ontology, hybrid search, optional semantic search by a local language model, and adaptive result ranking.
Multi-select for notes, note duplication, and draggable groups in the 2D graph.
Interface, documentation and website translations (11 languages), a first-run adventure, checklists, alarm notes, LaTeX formulas and title images.
